commHub.emergency.intro: Imagine: 5:30 AM, severe snowstorm, roads closed across Niedersachsen. Your phone is already in your hand — tap the red Emergency Alert button to start.
commHub.emergency.tap.agentReply: Quick — what's the situation? Just the gist, I'll formalize it.
commHub.emergency.enhanced.reply: Drafted in formal German and pre-selected all three channels. Review and tap Broadcast when ready.
commHub.emergency.broadcast.done: Sent across all {count} channel{plural} in 14 seconds. 412 of 412 parents reached.
commHub.consent.intro: Routine task — a permission slip for a 10th-grade biology field trip. I've dropped a Smart Form block onto the class page. Describe the trip and I'll fill in the standard fields.
commHub.consent.prompt.default: Permission slip for a biology trip to the forest on Friday, cost is 5 Euros.
commHub.consent.generated.reply: Drafted with the standard consent fields — Schüler:in, Klasse, Eltern-Unterschrift, Notfallkontakt, Diätbeschränkungen, plus the DSGVO Art. 6 consent checkbox. Review and route it.
commHub.consent.routing.userMessage: Send via Sdui Consent Module & Email.
commHub.consent.routing.reply: Sent to 30 parents. Here's what they see —
commHub.consent.dashboard.reply: Most parents have already signed. Here's the live consent dashboard — I've flagged the families who haven't responded yet so you can nudge them in one tap.
commHub.consent.reminder.userMessage: Send reminder to the 6 missing parents.
commHub.consent.reminder.reply: Reminders sent. I'll keep watching the form and flag any holdouts the day before the trip.
commHub.rail.emergency.whyBody: One pulsing button replaces a five-step menu. Defaults are right by default — every channel ON, AI handles formal language so you don't fight grammar at 5:30 AM.
commHub.rail.emergency.dsgvoBody: Emergency notifications fall under Art. 6 (1) d — vital interest. No additional consent required for safety-of-the-child broadcasts.
commHub.rail.consent.whyBody: One prompt populates the right fields. Smart Form ships routing built-in, so digital signatures land in the same dashboard regardless of channel.
commHub.rail.consent.dsgvoBody: Art. 6 (1) a — explicit consent captured with timestamp, IP, and digital signature. Withdrawal possible at any time from the parent's Sdui app.
commHub.rail.consent.channelBody: Sdui handles 80% of responses. Email picks up the long tail — parents without the app, grandparents, custody-share households.
